sections.label: Tagline
sections.content: Provides a dedicated success manager and a client-focused relationship, offering expertise in complex payroll scenarios like union payroll, and aiming to eliminate frustrations associated with larger, less personal payroll providers.

sections.label: Description
sections.content: Zuma Payroll & Processing is a full-service payroll and HR partner dedicated to providing personalized service to businesses, addressing common frustrations with larger providers such as inconsistent support and hidden fees. They offer a comprehensive suite of solutions to manage teams efficiently and accurately.
